Resolved Node.js and webpack-dev-server deprecation warnings

Luna now follows the Windows system accent color by default, with an option to use a custom accent instead. Centered PlayBar lyrics now use the space remaining between track information and player actions without letting long song information shrink the lyrics area unnecessarily.
